name: Tempester n°21: remote panel keys over MIDI (CC 102 = key press, CC 103 = key release)
explanation: The stock OS has no MIDI command for the panel keys. Physical path: Timer 3 sets [address] on every tick; the main loop then calls [routine](1) (PMP address 3 = message code) and [routine] ([address], PMP address 0 = data byte). Panel message 0x10 = key down and 0x11 = key up, data = key code 0-48: [routine] / [routine] update the key word [address] + 4 * code (pressed bit, swallow-release bit, hold counter) and call [routine](code, state), which fills the event [address] (signal 4, +4 key code, +5 bits 0-1 = 1 press, 2 release, 3 hold) and calls [routine] synchronously. Fix: [routine], which every received CC reaches from the main loop (DIN after the channel filter of [routine], USB unfiltered), jumps to a helper in free flash (0x9d07c200-0x9d07c297): CC 102 / 103 with value 0-48 on the Remote Pad IN channel ([address], 0 = All, the rule of CC 12/13) call [routine] / [routine] with the value as key code, exactly as panel messages 0x10 / 0x11, and are not published as event 10; any other CC, a value above 48 (would index past the 49 key words, into [address]) or another channel continues unchanged on the original path (NRPN reception hook of patch/nrpn_reception.json at [address], then event 10). Safety: a remote press of System (0x20) while both Shift key words (0x29 at [address], 0x2F at [address]) have bit 0 set (pressed, by the panel or by MIDI) is refused and follows the original path, so the Debug menu (voice calibration, which rewrites the voice flash) cannot be opened remotely; the release of System is not guarded. While the Debug menu is shown (UI state [address] = [address], opened on the panel), every remote key, press and release, is refused and follows the original path, so the Soft Key cannot start a Debug action remotely. Main loop context, as the panel; no RAM added. Holding Shift remotely works because CC 102 and 103 are separate (the key word keeps the pressed bit until the release). Applies on 1.5.0.2 alone and after nrpn_reception (it changes [address] / [address], not [address]).

edits.why: j 0x9d07c200 ; [routine]: was "andi a2,a2,0xff" (redone at KEYS). The delay slot "andi a3,a3,0xff" (value) is kept; the frame (addiu sp,sp,-0x20) is already allocated by the first instruction
replaced instruction. Live: a0 = source (1 DIN, 2 USB), a1 = channel 0-15, a2 = CC, a3 = value 0-127, sp = [routine] frame (ra slot 0x18), ra = caller
addiu t1,a2,-0x66 ; CC 102 or 103?
sltiu t1,t1,0x2
beq t1,zero,0x9d07c290 ; other CC: original path
sltiu t2,a3,0x31 ; delay slot: key code 0-48 (49 key words at [address]; [address] onwards is other data)
beq t2,zero,0x9d07c290 ; unknown key code: original path (stock behaviour, event 10 that no state uses)
lbu t3,0x49eb(gp) ; delay slot: Remote Pad IN channel [address] (0 = All)
beq t3,zero,0x9d07c22c ; All: any channel
addiu t3,t3,-0x1
bne a1,t3,0x9d07c290 ; other channel: original path
nop
lw t3,-0x7b68(gp) ; current UI state
lui t4,0x9d01
ori t4,t4,0xc40c
beq t3,t4,0x9d07c290 ; Debug menu shown (opened on the panel): every remote key, press and release, refused
nop
addiu t1,a2,-0x66
bne t1,zero,0x9d07c27c ; CC 103: release (never guarded)
li t2,0x20 ; delay slot: System key code
bne a3,t2,0x9d07c268 ; press of any key but System: delivered
lw t3,0x49bc(gp) ; delay slot: key word of Shift 0x29
lw t4,0x49d4(gp) ; key word of Shift 0x2f
and t3,t3,t4
andi t3,t3,0x1 ; bit 0 = pressed, set by [routine] whatever the source (panel or MIDI)
bne t3,zero,0x9d07c290 ; both Shift keys down + System = Debug menu (voice calibration): remote press refused, original path (event 10, ignored)
nop
sw ra,0x18(sp) ; own ra slot of [routine] (its epilogue at [address] reloads it)
jal [address] ; CC 102: key press, as panel message 0x10
or a0,a3,zero ; delay slot: a0 = key code
j [address] ; [routine] epilogue: lw ra,0x18(sp) / jr ra / addiu sp,sp,0x20
nop
sw ra,0x18(sp)
jal [address] ; CC 103: key release, as panel message 0x11
or a0,a3,zero ; delay slot: a0 = key code
j [address] ; [routine] epilogue
nop
j [address] ; back to [routine] after the replaced instruction (NRPN hook, then event 10)
nop
